import pandas as pd
from io import StringIO

# Load the data
data = """survived,pclass,sex,age,sibsp,parch,fare,embarked,class,who,adult_male,deck,embark_town,alive,alone
0,3,male,22.0,1,0,7.25,S,Third,man,True,,Southampton,no,False
1,1,female,38.0,1,0,71.2833,C,First,woman,False,C,Cherbourg,yes,False
1,3,female,26.0,0,0,7.925,S,Third,woman,False,,Southampton,yes,True

0,3,male,35.0,0,0,8.05,S,Third,man,True,,Southampton,no,True"""

df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(12, 10))
fig.suptitle('Titanic Dataset Analysis', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# Plot 1: Survival by Sex
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
survival_sex = df.groupby(['sex', 'survived']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
survival_sex.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['#d62728', '#2ca02c'])
ax1.set_title('Survival by Sex')
ax1.set_xlabel('Sex')
ax1.set_ylabel('Count')
ax1.legend(['Did not survive', 'Survived'])
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)

# Plot 2: Survival by Class
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
survival_class = df.groupby(['class', 'survived']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
survival_class.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax2, color=['#d62728', '#2ca02c'])
ax2.set_title('Survival by Passenger Class')
ax2.set_xlabel('Class')
ax2.set_ylabel('Count')
ax2.legend(['Did not survive', 'Survived'])
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)

# Plot 3: Age Distribution
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
colors = ['#d62728' if s == 0 else '#2ca02c' for s in df['survived']]
ax3.scatter(df['age'], df['fare'], c=colors, alpha=0.7, s=100)
ax3.set_title('Age vs Fare (colored by survival)')
ax3.set_xlabel('Age')
ax3.set_ylabel('Fare')
# Add legend manually
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
legend_elements = [Patch(facecolor='#d62728', label='Did not survive'),
                   Patch(facecolor='#2ca02c', label='Survived')]
ax3.legend(handles=legend_elements)

# Plot 4: Embark Town Distribution
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
embark_survival = df.groupby(['embark_town', 'survived']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
embark_survival.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax4, color=['#d62728', '#2ca02c'])
ax4.set_title('Survival by Embark Town')
ax4.set_xlabel('Embark Town')
ax4.set_ylabel('Count')
ax4.legend(['Did not survive', 'Survived'])
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
